items.stem:
Read the passage below, based on the story 'The Pot Maker', and answer.

"After her grandmother was gone, Tia found the old polishing stone in a basket by the hearth. It was worn smooth, shaped by years of rubbing pots until they gleamed. She held it in her palm and felt, for a moment, that she was holding her grandmother's hand. That night she kneaded her first lump of clay."

Answer the following:
(i) What did Tia find in the basket?  (a) An old polishing stone  (b) A letter  (c) A coin  (d) A clay pot
(ii) Why was the stone worn smooth?
(iii) What did holding the stone make Tia feel?
(iv) What does Tia's kneading her first lump of clay suggest?  (a) She will sell the stone  (b) She is angry with her grandmother  (c) She will give up pottery  (d) She will carry on her grandmother's craft.
items.answer: (i) (a) An old polishing stone (ii) It had been used for years to rub/polish pots until they gleamed. (iii) That she was holding her grandmother's hand – close to her grandmother. (iv) (d) She will carry on her grandmother's craft.
items.markingKey: (i) (a) An old polishing stone (ii) It had been used for years to rub/polish pots until they gleamed. (iii) That she was holding her grandmother's hand – close to her grandmother. (iv) (d) She will carry on her grandmother's craft. (1 mark each, 4 marks.)
